name: raycast-fly
title: Fly.io
description: View and manage your Fly.io applications and machines
author: devuo

commands.name: search-apps
commands.title: Search Apps
commands.description: Search and manage your Fly.io applications

commands.name: search-machines
commands.title: Search Machines
commands.description: Search and manage Fly.io machines across your apps

tools.name: get-apps
tools.title: Get Apps
tools.description: List all Fly.io applications with their state, organization, machine count, and regions

tools.name: get-machines
tools.title: Get Machines
tools.description: List all machines for a specific Fly.io app with their state, region, CPU, and memory

tools.name: get-volumes
tools.title: Get Volumes
tools.description: List all volumes for a specific Fly.io app with name, size, region, and state

tools.name: get-secrets
tools.title: Get Secrets
tools.description: List secret names for a specific Fly.io app (values are never exposed)

tools.name: restart-machine
tools.title: Restart Machine
tools.description: Restart a specific machine in a Fly.io app

tools.name: start-machine
tools.title: Start Machine
tools.description: Start a stopped machine in a Fly.io app

tools.name: stop-machine
tools.title: Stop Machine
tools.description: Stop a running machine in a Fly.io app

tools.name: destroy-machine
tools.title: Destroy Machine
tools.description: Permanently destroy a machine in a Fly.io app. This cannot be undone.

ai.instructions: Use the Fly.io tools to help users manage their applications and machines. Always list apps or machines first to get valid names and IDs before performing actions. Never guess machine IDs. Secret values are never exposed — only names are available.

preferences.name: authToken
preferences.title: Authentication Token
preferences.description: Fly.io authentication token (or use Generate Token in the setup guide)

preferences.name: flyBinaryPath
preferences.title: Fly CLI Path
preferences.description: Custom path to the fly binary (leave empty for auto-detection)
